en.html:
At the edge of the dawn sky, something screamed.

Painful.

Only pitiful.

That was a being intent on destroying the world.

Even so, I thought:

I want to save her.

Protect her.

Not the world.
One girl trembling alone in that sky.

en.html:
I wanted to protect her.

Even with the world against me.

Whatever the sacrifice.

Protect her.

Could not kill her.

I could never kill Hikaru.

Protecting Hikaru Minato was Kageaki Minato's life.

—And.

Killing Hikaru Minato was Kageaki Minato's responsibility.

—Both were true.

This contradiction.

Beyond this contradiction, I must kill Hikaru.

…Therefore.

Only one System of Art could overturn it.

ja.html:
俺は守りたい。

　例え世界を敵に回そうと。

　どんな犠牲を払う事になろうと。

　守りたい。

　殺せない。

　俺は決して光を殺せない。

　湊斗光を守る事が、湊斗景明の命。

　――であり。

　湊斗光を殺す事が、湊斗景明の<ruby>責<rt>つとめ</rt></ruby>。

　――である。

　この矛盾。

　この矛盾を超えて、俺は光を殺さなくてはならない。

　……従って。
　
　矛盾を覆す唯一つの<ruby>魔剣論理<rt>システムオブアート</rt></ruby>が導かれる。
